main_text.p: si ab eâdem causa perfequenda abstineamus, ex quo Iehouam Deum nostrum & Ecclesiam Dominum Iehouæ Dei nostri per Scripturas sacras didicimus? Quapropter (ut ait Apostolus) Ephes. 5.expergiscamur qui dormimus, & surgamus à mortuis, & illucescet nobis Christus. Intueamur semper in illam essentiam distinam [?], quæ principium est omnis boni, tum natura communi, tum gratia erga nos singulariter. Hebr. 12.Intueamur in Patrem illum omnipotentem, qui nos dedit filio in Ecclesiam colligendos: Intueamur in fidei ducem ac perfectorem Iesum, qui pro gaudio sibi propositò pertulit crucem, & ad dextram throni Dei consedit, quò nos euehæret [?]: Intueamur in Spiritu illum patris & filij habitantem in nobis, & testante spiritui nostro nos esse filios Dei, & templa sancta Domino: Intueamur in Ecclesiam, in quam velut templum lectissimum Deus nos convocat, ut per eam ad se contendamus virtute æterni spiritus viuentis in nobis. hæ causæ nos ita moverint, ut cæteras causas dimoveant ex mentibus nostris, & rapiant ad sanctissimum illud studium, cuius hic Propheta meminit, & seipsum exhibet typum in pietate & sanctimonia ad hæc officia præ-tarum.
Quid ergo est officij, quod Propheta hoc loco prædicat? Quæram [?], inquit, sive procurabe quod bonum est tibi, ô Ierusalem, vel domus Iehouæ. Procurantur quæ adsunt, ut augeantur atque confer-

page.notes: Printed text is set in a long-s face; long s has been read as s throughout. Doubtful readings: "distinam" (printed distinam, may be a damaged or abbreviated word), "euehæret" (printed euehçret, last letters unclear), "Quæram" (printed Quáram, accent unclear), "procurabe" (printed as shown, may be procurabo). The line "tarum." after "præ-" is the end of the word split across lines; the full word is unclear. A stray mark of small dashes stands below the "tarum." line and is not text. The paragraph beginning "Quid ergo" is indented with a leading mark that is not printed text. The margin notes "Ephes. 5." and "Hebr. 12." are in the left margin.
